hostPorts.purpose: Create and observe external payment processor intents from the API host.
Apply available settlement wallet balance as checkout credit without Payments querying Settlement storage.

payments.purpose: Own payments feature behavior, read models, and UI contracts for the payments context.
payments.allowedWhen: Always; slice directories are the default root shape for implemented context features.

refunds.purpose: Own refunds feature behavior, read models, and UI contracts for the payments context.
refunds.allowedWhen: Always; slice directories are the default root shape for implemented context features.

request-support.purpose: Provide reusable request-support assets shared by payments-owned features and composition seams.
request-support.allowedWhen: Allowed only when capability cannot stay inside one feature and cross-feature reuse is explicit.
request-support.justification: request-support centralizes context-local composition that should not duplicate across features.
request-support.createdFor: payments workflows that span multiple features or public entrypoints.
request-support.sunsetWhen: Remove when all consumers can move the behavior back into feature-local modules.

runtime-support.purpose: Provide reusable runtime-support assets shared by payments-owned features and composition seams.
runtime-support.allowedWhen: Allowed only when capability cannot stay inside one feature and cross-feature reuse is explicit.
runtime-support.justification: runtime-support centralizes context-local composition that should not duplicate across features.
runtime-support.createdFor: payments workflows that span multiple features or public entrypoints.
runtime-support.sunsetWhen: Remove when all consumers can move the behavior back into feature-local modules.

seed-support.allowedWhen: Allowed only when capability cannot stay inside one feature and cross-feature reuse is explicit.
seed-support.justification: seed-support centralizes context-local composition that should not duplicate across features.
seed-support.createdFor: payments workflows that span multiple features or public entrypoints.
seed-support.sunsetWhen: Remove when all consumers can move the behavior back into feature-local modules.

ucp-support.purpose: Provide Payments-owned UCP payment-handler declarations and AP2 guarded-completion decisions.
ucp-support.allowedWhen: Allowed because UCP payment-handler handoff is an external protocol adapter over Payments-owned payment risk decisions.
ucp-support.justification: Payments owns payment handlers and AP2 mandate acceptance; Checkout only coordinates the trusted checkout session.
ucp-support.sunsetWhen: Move into a Payments feature slice when production AP2 mandate verification is implemented.

routes.purpose: Expose payments-owned route modules consumed by generated deployable adapters.
routes.allowedWhen: Required whenever the context contributes routes to any deployable.
